n4309151f90.headline: OGDC Explores JV in Libya and Vietnam with Russian, Turkish Partners
n4309151f90.summary: Pakistan's Oil and Gas Development Company is seeking to expand overseas through partnerships with Russian and Turkish partners. The talks cover ventures in Libya and Vietnam.
n4309151f90.why: OGDC is Pakistan's largest oil and gas explorer, and its overseas joint ventures would affect its growth and exposure to international upstream projects.

naf6849a403.headline: Malawi: Trade Deficit Widens 20% in 11 Months, Deepening Cost-of-Living Crisis
naf6849a403.summary: New data show Malawi buying far more from abroad than it sells, with the trade deficit widening 20% over 11 months. The imbalance is adding pressure on prices, jobs and the value of the kwacha.
naf6849a403.why: A widening trade deficit typically weakens a currency and raises import costs, which matters for investors assessing frontier-market macroeconomic risk.

n8be8f69525.headline: Qualco Group announces full acquisition of D.D. SYNERGY
n8be8f69525.summary: Qualco Group announced it has fully acquired D.D. Synergy, founded in 1999 and described as one of the largest SAP business partners in Greece. The company provides customised SAP solutions.
n8be8f69525.why: SAP consulting partners are a key part of enterprise software implementation, and consolidation in the sector can change competitive dynamics in Greece.

n241719aff6.headline: Citi Moves Toward Russia Exit Despite $1.2 Billion Loss
n241719aff6.summary: Citigroup said the sale of its Russian subsidiary will ultimately be beneficial, despite currency-driven losses of $1.2 billion. The US-based bank is moving toward exiting Russia.
n241719aff6.why: Citigroup is a large US-based global bank whose overseas exits and currency-related write-downs affect its earnings and capital position.

n9422883713.headline: Australian stocks underperformed global peers in 2025
n9422883713.summary: Australian stocks underperformed global peers in 2025, with small caps, gold miners and the big banks among the key investment themes. The review covers the year's market performance.
n9422883713.why: The ASX 200 is Australia's main benchmark index and is heavily weighted toward banks and miners, so its relative performance reflects both domestic and commodity exposure.

n58ba945d91.headline: Smallcap Index Faces Worst Year Since 2018
n58ba945d91.summary: Over 50 per cent, or 660 stocks, from the BSE 1000 index recorded negative returns during calendar 2025. The smallcap segment is on track for its worst year since 2018.
n58ba945d91.why: Smallcap stocks are more volatile and more sensitive to domestic liquidity and risk appetite, so their weakness signals broader pressure on mid-tier Indian equities.

n9df25055b3.headline: "Iran Protests Spread Over Inflation and Currency Crisis" – Chennaionline
n9df25055b3.summary: Protests in Iran over rising prices and a sharp fall in the national currency have continued for a third day and spread beyond Tehran to several other cities, after shopkeepers struck at the Grand Bazaar.
n9df25055b3.why: Iran's currency and inflation pressures affect sanctions-hit trade, energy exports and regional investor risk perceptions.

n9d68bf4684.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Ends 2025 with 44.3% Gain
n9d68bf4684.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed 2025 with a 44.3% rise. The gain was boosted by record liquidity, foreign investment and Euronext integration.
n9d68bf4684.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its performance reflects investor sentiment toward Greek companies and the broader Greek economy.

n71af9a71d3.headline: Greek Economy 2025 Review: Key Reforms & 2026 Outlook
n71af9a71d3.summary: Greek Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis outlined the major economic reforms of 2025 and set out the stage for the pivotal 2026 budget.
n71af9a71d3.why: Greece's fiscal policy and reform agenda shape government bond spreads and investor confidence in the Greek economy.

na9ecf2acf4.headline: Global stock markets under pressure after Trump’s latest tariff blow
na9ecf2acf4.summary: US President Donald Trump signed an executive order setting new tariffs on a range of US trading partners. The tariffs take effect on August 7 and pressured global stock markets.
na9ecf2acf4.why: US tariff policy affects trade flows, corporate margins and inflation expectations for companies and economies worldwide.
na9ecf2acf4.why_moved: A new executive order sets tariffs on multiple US trading partners, which unsettled global equity markets ahead of the August 7 effective date.

nb492e3433a.headline: Bulgaria Joins Eurozone in 2026, Says Pierrakakis
nb492e3433a.summary: Bulgaria enters the eurozone on January 1, 2026, according to Eurogroup President Kyriakos Pierrakakis. He called the move a boost for the euro and European unity.
nb492e3433a.why: Euro adoption expands the single currency area, affecting monetary policy transmission, exchange-rate exposure and capital flows for members.

ne29756f3aa.headline: Rupee Ends 2025 With 70-Day Winning Streak Against US Dollar Intact
ne29756f3aa.summary: The Pakistani rupee closed higher against the US dollar for the 70th consecutive day on Wednesday to end 2025. The currency also posted further gains, according to the report.
ne29756f3aa.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and external debt servicing for Pakistan, which matter to emerging-market investors.

ncb5d28726a.headline: Nigeria: Central Bank Forecasts $51bn External Reserves in 2026
ncb5d28726a.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria projects external reserves will rise to $51.04 billion in 2026. It cites foreign exchange reforms, stronger export earnings, steady remittances and improved domestic refining.
ncb5d28726a.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria manages the country's reserves and currency policy. Reserve levels signal the capacity to defend the naira and meet external obligations.

n21ed5cd784.headline: China’s Juneyao Air to purchase twenty-five A320
n21ed5cd784.summary: Shanghai-based Juneyao Air plans to purchase 25 A320-family aircraft, valued at about €3.8 billion at list prices. Deliveries are scheduled between 2028 and 2032, subject to regulatory approval.
n21ed5cd784.why: Airbus is a European aircraft maker whose narrowbody A320 family is a major source of commercial aircraft orders. Large airline orders shape its backlog and production plans.

impacts.name: Airbus
impacts.why: A 25-aircraft order from a Chinese carrier adds to Airbus's future delivery backlog.

n37955c1edc.headline: NNPC reports N502bn profit after tax, says crude oil output hit 1.6m bpd in November
n37955c1edc.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company reported a N502bn profit after tax. It said crude oil and condensate output rose to 1.6 million barrels per day in November 2025.
n37955c1edc.why: NNPC Limited is Nigeria's state oil company, and its output and profits feed into government revenue and the country's oil export earnings.

nf3b421f67c.headline: Protests sparked by inflation spread across Iran
nf3b421f67c.summary: A protest led by Iranian shopkeepers in Tehran has spread to major cities across Iran as the economic crisis deepens. The demonstrations are driven by inflation.
nf3b421f67c.why: Iran's economy faces sanctions and high inflation, and social unrest can affect the rial currency, trade flows and the outlook for energy exports.

n96dbf287f2.headline: Govt Freezes Vodafone-Ideas Dues, Grants A 5-Year Moratorium On Payments
n96dbf287f2.summary: India's Union Cabinet approved a relief package for Vodafone Idea, freezing its outstanding dues and granting a five-year moratorium on payments. The telecom operator is heavily indebted.
n96dbf287f2.why: Vodafone Idea is an Indian mobile telecom operator whose finances depend heavily on government dues and debt relief.

nfa407ca187.headline: 2025: PM Modis visit marks  upswing in Sri Lanka-India ties
nfa407ca187.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's April visit to Sri Lanka marked an upswing in bilateral ties, including military cooperation, as the island showed signs of recovery from economic stress.
nfa407ca187.why: India and Sri Lanka's relations affect regional trade, investment and financial support flows, which matter to investors in South Asia.

n4f4111db73.headline: Rupee to grapple incessant volatility in 2026; US trade pact may not be silver bullet
n4f4111db73.summary: The Indian rupee faces global trade disruptions and heavy foreign fund outflows and is unlikely to stop its decline until tariff impacts ease. The RBI sees the rupee's path as uncertain.
n4f4111db73.why: The rupee's value affects India's import costs, foreign investment returns and the cost of dollar-denominated debt.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: Outflows and trade disruption are cited as pressures keeping the rupee under weakness.

n9cc312f158.headline: Household energy bills to rise as snow and gales forecast
n9cc312f158.summary: Household energy bills in the UK will rise after Ofgem's energy price cap increased by 0.2, as cold weather health alerts are issued for large areas of the country.
n9cc312f158.why: Ofgem sets the price cap that limits what suppliers can charge UK households per unit of energy. Changes feed into consumer spending power and inflation.

n7ec5d8472f.headline: IANS Year Ender 2025: A year of strains, signals and slow repair for India–US partnership
n7ec5d8472f.summary: India-US relations ran into trouble in 2025 after a positive start, with political differences, trade disputes and sharp public messaging testing the partnership. Both sides moved to repair ties slowly.
n7ec5d8472f.why: India and the United States are major trading partners, and trade policy between them affects tariffs, supply chains and investment flows. Diplomatic tensions can influence trade negotiations.

nc7e7eb0c99.headline: US Commits $2 Billion For Foreign Aid But Tells Agencies To 'Adapt, Shrink, Or Die'
nc7e7eb0c99.summary: The US has finalized a $2 billion foreign aid commitment that supports the UN's 2026 plan to reach nearly 90 million people across 17 crisis-affected countries. Agencies were told to adapt, shrink, or die.
nc7e7eb0c99.why: US foreign aid funding shapes humanitarian spending and government budget priorities that investors watch in fiscal policy debates.

na27c4e6ad2.headline: Wall Street falls in light trading on the final day of 2025, another banner year for markets
na27c4e6ad2.summary: Wall Street fell in light trading on the final trading day of 2025. The year was described as a banner one for markets, driven by both optimism and uncertainty.
na27c4e6ad2.why: The S&P 500 is a benchmark index of large US companies and is widely used to gauge the health of the US equity market.

n8cec4c957f.headline: Indonesia's trade surplus seen widening to $3 billion in November
n8cec4c957f.summary: Indonesia's trade surplus is likely to have widened to $3 billion in November from a month earlier. Exports were expected to have shrunk further on a yearly basis, according to a Reuters poll.
n8cec4c957f.why: The trade balance feeds into current account and rupiah dynamics, which matter to investors in Indonesian assets.

nf54a8d154e.headline: Singapore shares slip 0.2% on final trading day of the year; STI up 22.7% in 2025
nf54a8d154e.summary: Singapore shares slipped 0.2% on the final trading day of the year. The iEdge Singapore Next 50 Index shed 0.1% to end at 1,450.13, while the STI gained 22.7% in 2025.
nf54a8d154e.why: The Straits Times Index is Singapore's benchmark equity index, tracking the largest local listed companies.

nc5bb22673c.headline: Nvidia eyes chips from TSMC - Taipei Times
nc5bb22673c.summary: A Taipei Times report says Nvidia is looking at chips from TSMC. The report provides no further details in the available description.
nc5bb22673c.why: Nvidia designs AI graphics chips and depends on TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, for manufacturing.

n3503b86181.headline: Wall Street holds steady in light trading on the final day of 2025
n3503b86181.summary: Wall Street held steady in light trading at the start of the final session of 2025. The AP report calls 2025 a banner year for markets.
n3503b86181.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US companies, and year-end trading conditions help set the closing performance for the year.

ncc988cb488.headline: Taiwan market closes out year at historic high - Taipei Times
ncc988cb488.summary: Taiwan's stock market closed out the year at a historic high. The Taipei Times report gives no further figures in the available description.
ncc988cb488.why: Taiwan's benchmark index is heavily weighted toward semiconductor companies, so its level reflects global chip demand.

nf1c149cc3e.headline: Manila posts P10.8 billion revenue
nf1c149cc3e.summary: The Manila city government collected P10.8 billion in revenue from July to December, according to Mayor Isko Moreno.
nf1c149cc3e.why: City revenue figures indicate the fiscal capacity of the Philippine capital, which funds local services and investment.

ne098efc043.headline: NT dollar rose 4.27% against US dollar in 2025, highest in 5 years - Taipei Times
ne098efc043.summary: The New Taiwan dollar rose over 4% against the US dollar in 2025, its biggest annual gain in five years. The US dollar closed at NT$31.438 on the final trading session of the year.
ne098efc043.why: Taiwan hosts major semiconductor manufacturers, so the currency's moves affect exporters' earnings and the island's trade balance.

impacts.name: New Taiwan dollar
impacts.why: The article reports the New Taiwan dollar's annual gain against the US dollar in 2025.
